resolution_steps: Set ospf area 0 network type to point-to-point
Restart ospfd service on router 10.1.1.1
Update nft rule 100 to allow OSPF packets on interface eth0

bonus.root_cause: The OSPF backbone area was misconfigured with the wrong network type.

resolution_steps: Restart ingress controller with --v=5 flag
Set etcd key /ingress/config/max-workers to 4
Update helm chart with new ingress config values
Verify etcdctl get /ingress/config returns updated values

bonus.root_cause: Ingress controller configuration was not properly synced with etcd.

resolution_steps: Set edns-buffer-size to 1232 in /etc/resolver/config
Restart resolver daemon with systemctl restart resolver
Verify new buffer size with dig +edns=1232 example.com
Monitor DNS resolution times with mtr --dns example.com

bonus.root_cause: EDNS0 buffer size mismatch caused fragmentation that the upstream resolver dropped silently.

resolution_steps: Restart alertmanager with --alertmanager.cluster.advertise-address=192.168.1.10:9093
Set cluster.peer_timeout to 30s in alertmanager.yml
Increase alertmanager.cluster.gossip_interval to 5s
Verify alertmanager configuration with promtool check config /etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml

bonus.root_cause: The alertmanager cluster was not properly configured with the correct advertise address.

resolution_steps: Restart metrics ingestion service with --port 8080
Set scrape_interval to 15s in /etc/prometheus/config.yml
Increase log level to DEBUG for pipeline errors
Verify wal_dir path is set to /var/lib/prometheus/wal

bonus.root_cause: The metrics ingestion pipeline failed to start due to misconfigured port settings.

resolution_steps: Clear session token cache at /var/cache/sessions
Restart authentication service with --debug flag
Set session_timeout to 3600 in /etc/auth/config
Verify ldapsearch connectivity to ldap://localhost:389

bonus.root_cause: The session token cache became corrupted due to incorrect timeout settings.

resolution_steps: Restart router with config file /etc/network/config.txt
Set BGP hold time to 30 seconds in /etc/quagga/daemons
Update route reflector IP to 10.1.2.3 in /etc/network/routes
Apply new firewall rules with nft -f /etc/nftables.conf

bonus.root_cause: The WAN aggregation router misconfiguration caused packet loss.

resolution_steps: Restart primary SQL replica on host db01
Set max_connections to 500 in postgresql.conf
Adjust pgbouncer.ini to increase max_db_connections to 200
Run VACUUM FULL on tables with high bloat factor
Analyze query plans using EXPLAIN ANALYZE

bonus.root_cause: The primary SQL replica experienced connection exhaustion due to misconfigured max connections.

resolution_steps: Set negative-TTL to 60s in /etc/resolv.conf
Add second upstream resolver 8.8.8.8 to /etc/resolv.conf
Restart resolver service with systemctl restart resolv
Verify failover with dig +trace example.com

bonus.root_cause: Recursive resolver hit upstream rate limit on a single authoritative zone.

resolution_steps: Restart multipathd service on node01
Set max_queue_depth to 64 in /etc/multipath.conf
Run fio --filename=/dev/mapper/mpath0 --size=10G --rw=randwrite
Verify snapshot size with rsync --dry-run -avz /mnt/src/ /mnt/dst/
Adjust snapshot timeout to 300 seconds in /etc/snapshot.conf

bonus.root_cause: The block storage volume snapshot failed due to insufficient queue depth.

resolution_steps: Set initialDelaySeconds to 60s on liveness probe
Add startupProbe with failureThreshold 30
Update deployment config with new probe settings
Apply updated config using helm upgrade

bonus.root_cause: Liveness probe killed container prematurely due to short interval.

resolution_steps: Restart directory service on node 1
Set replication interval to 300 seconds
Verify ldapsearch connectivity to node 2 on port 389
Run pam-test with debug flag to check auth flow

bonus.root_cause: Directory replication failed due to incorrect configuration.

resolution_steps: Restart read-replica with max_connections set to 500
Set replica lag threshold to 30 seconds in pgbouncer.ini
Adjust iostat interval to 10 seconds for closer monitoring
Run explain analyze on slow queries to identify bottlenecks

bonus.root_cause: The read-replica pair fell behind due to excessive connection overload.

resolution_steps: Restart kubelet on node 3
Set maxPods to 110 in /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf
Run crictl pods to verify pod counts
Adjust kubelet flags with --max-pods=110
Verify node capacity with stern --tail 100

bonus.root_cause: The kubelet on node 3 was misconfigured with too low a maxPods value.

resolution_steps: Restart feature-flag service on node 3
Set cache ttl to 300 seconds in /etc/flag/config.yaml
Run registry-gc with --dry-run flag to identify unused flags

bonus.root_cause: The feature-flag service failed to update due to a stale cache.

resolution_steps: Restart runner 17 with flag --max-retries=5
Set registry_gc_interval to 30m in /etc/runner/config.toml
Run registry-gc --dry-run to identify unused images
Remove unused images older than 14d with registry-gc --delete
Update CI config with new runner-image version 1.2.3

bonus.root_cause: The CI runner pool exhausted its capacity due to a lack of garbage collection.

resolution_steps: Stop logical replication
Set wal_sender_timeout to 60s
Restart slot with slot_name = my_slot
Clear backlog with pg_rewind -s my_slot

bonus.root_cause: Logical replication slot my_slot was not properly restarted after a timeout.

resolution_steps: Set saml.assertion.lifetime to 3600 in /etc/saml/gateway.conf
Restart saml-gateway service with systemctl restart saml-gateway
Verify IDP metadata at https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml
Decode SAML response with jwt.io equivalent decoder to check expiration

bonus.root_cause: The SAML federation gateway was configured with an incorrect assertion lifetime.

resolution_steps: Restart DNS server with --dns-cache-size=1000
Set dns.cache.ttl=3600 in /etc/dns/config.yaml
Run registry-gc --dry-run to check for stale records
Remove expired records with vault-cli delete --path=/dns/records/expired
Update flag-history with --dns-server-version=1.2.3

bonus.root_cause: The internal DNS cache was not properly configured and exceeded its maximum size of 500 entries.

resolution_steps: Set cluster-autoscaler.log-level to 4
Restart cluster-autoscaler with --v=4 flag
Edit /etc/cluster-autoscaler/config.yaml scale-down-unneeded-time to 10m

bonus.root_cause: The cluster autoscaler was not scaling down due to incorrect log level and config.

resolution_steps: Restart directory replication service on node 3
Set replication delay to 30 seconds in /etc/dirsync.conf
Update pam-test configuration to use the new directory endpoint
Verify jwt.io equivalent decoder output for authentication headers

bonus.root_cause: Directory replication failed due to misconfigured SSL certificates.

resolution_steps: Set nft table ip filter priority to 10
Update anycast VIP rule to use ip saddr 192.0.2.1
Reload nft configuration from /etc/nftables.conf

bonus.root_cause: The anycast VIP route was not properly configured with the correct IP address.

resolution_steps: Restart tracing collector service on node 10.0.2.15
Set tsdb.max_idle_connections to 50 in /etc/tsdb.conf
Increase trace-buffer-size to 1048576 in /etc/trace-config.yaml
Run tsdb-cli with --repair option to fix corrupted indexes

bonus.root_cause: The tracing collector service failed to start due to a corrupted database index.

resolution_steps: Restart multipathd service with -v flag
Set max_polling_interval to 10 in /etc/multipath.conf
Remove failed paths using multipath -f
Verify path priority with multipath -ll

bonus.root_cause: The SAN multipath driver failed to properly configure path priorities.

resolution_steps: Set max_client_conn to 200 in pg_hba.conf
Add pgbouncer in front of batch job on port 5433
Configure pgbouncer to use pool_mode and pool_size 100
Increase per-IP connection limit from 50 to 200 in postgresql.conf

bonus.root_cause: Background job opened many short-lived connections that exhausted the per-IP connection limit of 50.

resolution_steps: Restart object storage service on node 3 with --force flag
Set replication factor to 3 in /etc/objectstorage/config.yaml
Run rsync --dry-run -avz /mnt/data/ to test replication sync
Verify multipath -ll output for healthy storage paths on all nodes
Adjust smartctl -a /dev/sdb settings to optimize disk performance

bonus.root_cause: The object storage bucket replication failed due to a misconfigured replication factor.

resolution_steps: Restart registry service on node 3
Set max_connections to 50 in /etc/registry/config.yml
Clear cache at /var/lib/registry/cache
Update broker-admin flag --registry-retry-count to 3

bonus.root_cause: The build artifact registry exceeded its connection limit.

resolution_steps: Restart synthetic-probe runner with --log-level=debug flag
Set tsdb.retention-period to 30d in /etc/tsdb.conf
Run promtool to reload tsdb configuration
Verify probe-runner.log contains no errors after restart

bonus.root_cause: The synthetic-probe runner was not properly configured to handle increased load.

resolution_steps: Restart kubelet on node-1 with --pod-infra-container-image flag
Set max-pods to 110 in /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf
Run etcdctl member list to verify cluster health
Apply kustomize overlay to update node-1 configuration

bonus.root_cause: The node kubelet was misconfigured with an outdated pod infra container image.

resolution_steps: Restart metadata server on node 3 with --force-reload flag
Set /etc/metadata/server.conf replication_factor to 3
Run multipath -ll to verify path status on all nodes
Execute s3-style CLI command put-object --bucket mybucket --key metadata/check to test write access

bonus.root_cause: The distributed filesystem metadata server experienced a failure due to an incorrectly configured replication factor.
